review.algorithm_assessment: Enumerate all subsets of the at most eight subnet purchases. Each purchase contracts all of its cities for free after its fixed price is paid. First compute one MST of the complete squared-distance graph with dense Prim. When zero-cost connectivity edges are added, some MST of the augmented graph uses only the old MST plus the added edges: discard every non-tree original edge using its no-heavier original tree path and the cycle property. Therefore each purchase subset only needs DSU contraction followed by Kruskal on the n-1 cached MST edges, not on all city pairs. Compare total purchase plus construction cost over all subsets.
review.limitations: One source reviewer plus actual isolated tests, not independent dual semantic review.
